description: Disables all AdMob preloading, bypasses interstitial ads, and auto-removes the watermark on receipt screens without user interaction.
name: Remove All Ads

description: Disables automatic screen pinning / lock task mode so the app is not pinned to the screen.
name: Remove Auto-Pin App

description: Removes FLAG_SECURE so screenshots and screen recording work normally during the exam.
name: Remove Screenshot Protection

description: Always shows the custom server settings button on the login screen, enabling connection to self-hosted Habitica backends without a secret gesture.
name: Self-Hosted Server Support

description: Injects a JavaScript monkeypatch into the exam WebView on every page load that freezes the Page Visibility API (document.hidden, document.visibilityState, document.hasFocus) and silently drops blur/visibilitychange/focusout event listeners. This prevents the web-side exam platform from detecting when the browser loses focus or is backgrounded.
name: Suppress WebView Exam Events

description: Stops Telegram sending its storage-type statistic and how long you spent on each channel post to its server. Also stops reports about Premium screen views, feature taps, accepts and purchase failures. Messages and calls work as before.
name: Disable analytics

description: Stops automatic call debug reports and log-file uploads requested by Telegram's server.
name: Disable call debug upload

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops a sideways swipe on a chat in the chat list from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read. A swipe set to change folders still does. Long-press keeps every action.
name: Disable chat swipe actions

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops reactions from a double tap in chats and the reaction-settings preview. Scrolling, taps, selection and explicit reaction menus keep their usual behavior.
name: Disable double-tap reactions

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that stops Telegram fetching link previews for messages you haven't sent yet, in chats, the share sheet, polls, story links and bot shares. Sent messages still get their preview.
name: Disable draft link previews

description: Adds a switch, on by default, that stops pulling past the bottom of a channel from opening the next channel. Scrolling, opening channels directly and pulling between forum topics still work.
name: Disable pull to next channel

description: Stops telegram.org's Telegram offering its own updates, which can't install over a patched build. Patch the new version in Morphe Manager instead.
name: Disable update checks

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. Tapping the camera tile starts it.
name: Gallery camera on tap

description: Hides the sponsored messages in channels, the sponsored accounts in search and the ads in Telegram's video player. Telegram never asks for them, so none are counted as seen.
name: Hide ads

description: Hides the Popular apps list in search's Apps tab and stops Telegram from asking its server for it. Apps you've opened and other search results stay.
name: Hide popular apps

description: Hides Premium, Stars, My Grams, Business and Send a Gift in Settings, profile Gifts tabs and the channel Gift button. Purchases and account controls keep their usual behavior.
name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars

description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners in the chat list. Account security notices and other suggestions remain. Nothing is dismissed for you.
name: Hide promotional banners

description: Hides similar channels and bots, including cached recommendations. Telegram doesn't ask for new recommendations while the switch is on.
name: Hide recommendations

description: Hides a proxy's sponsored channel from the chat list and folders. Leaves proxy settings and shared promo-data updates alone.
name: Hide sponsored proxy channel

description: Hides the chat-list story bar, avatar story rings and Post Story button, and stops fetching the story list. Profile stories and archives remain available.
name: Hide Stories

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that puts a Santa hat over the chat list logo and keeps Telegram's New Year snow falling all year over the chat list's top bar and chat backgrounds. Telegram's own holiday dates apply while it's off.
name: Holiday look all year

description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings. You can also long-press Telegram's launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Telegram's App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushTelegram settings

description: Opens ordinary HTTP(S) links in your browser. Telegram links, login, payment and authenticated routes keep their existing behavior.
name: Open links externally

description: Keeps the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again, and clears its warning badge, once you've said no. The first request, the tab's own buttons and contact sync stay as they are.
name: Quiet contacts nag

description: Restores Telegram's official certificate header in Firebase Installations requests on re-signed builds. Other signature checks keep their usual behavior.
name: Repair Firebase push registration

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that shows a copyable local user or chat ID in the inspected profile's menu. It doesn't expose access hashes or ask Telegram's server for anything.
name: Show user and chat IDs

description: Optional local cleaning at link-open and Share Link chooser sites. Removes only utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, gclid and fbclid. Any unknown query key preserves the entire URL. Off by default in settings.
name: Strip link tracking

description: Adds a switch, off by default, that pastes text with Android's plain-text action. Whitespace and URLs stay intact without Telegram's HTML, table or monospace conversion. Other clipboard actions stay available.
name: Use normal paste

description: Uses your Google Maps Android SDK key, authorized for Telegram's package and the installed signer. Leaving the option unset keeps the original key.
name: Use registered Maps API key

options.description: An Android SDK key from your Google Cloud project. Restrict it to the app package and your signing certificate SHA-1.
options.title: Registered Maps API key

description: Uses the API ID and hash registered for your application at my.telegram.org. Supply both patch options. Leaving both unset keeps the original credentials.
name: Use registered Telegram API credentials

options.description: The positive application ID from your Telegram API development tools.
options.title: Registered API ID

options.description: The 32 hexadecimal characters paired with that API ID. Keep this value in local patch inputs.
options.title: Registered API hash

description: Adds 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, and 2.0x playback speed options.
name: Add fast playback speeds

description: Adds a Fit/Stretch toggle to the player.
name: Aspect ratio control

description: Enables playback speed options (0.5x-2.0x) in the video player.
name: Enable speed control

description: Adds a floating panel to change playback speed and stretch, crop or zoom the picture.
name: Playback speed and aspect ratio

description: Removes pre-roll and mid-roll video ads, and the display banners.
name: Remove ads

description: Adds subtitle size, font and outline controls to the player.
name: Subtitle styling

description: Hides the comments panel beside the player on tablets and unfolded foldables.
name: Use the whole screen for video

description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Always show publish date

description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.
name: Copy comments without username

description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit of up to 500 videos.
name: Custom offline videos limit

description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local Java crash capture.
name: Diagnostic tools

description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.
name: Disable login requirement

description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.
name: Disable long-press quick share

description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.
name: Disable screen capture detection

description: Adds a Miscellaneous toggle that disables ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution tracking, BDLocation background uploads, Firebase Analytics, and crash reporting. Off by default.
name: Disable telemetry

description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.
name: Downloads

description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.
name: Enable Live search

description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.
name: Enable non-personalized search

description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.
name: Feature Gate Lab

description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, the playlist bar, the floating event badge, AI-generated posts, paid partnership and promotional content, friend recommendations, posts from verified accounts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.
name: Feed filter

description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.
name: Feed tab navigation

description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.
name: Fix Google login

description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.
name: Hide CAPTCHA popups

description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.
name: Hide quick comment reactions

description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.
name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock

description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Open external links directly

description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.
name: Playback speed

description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.
name: Remember clear display

description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.
name: Resume videos after scrolling

description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Adds the Morphe patches settings menu to TikTok.
name: Settings

description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.
name: Show seekbar

description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.
name: Show seekbar thumbnail

description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.
name: SIM spoof

description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.
name: Stop video looping

description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
name: Translate comments

description: Plays only the tapped track of a playlist or album, or adds it to the queue, instead of replacing the queue with the whole playlist.
name: Playlist track tap action

options.description: What tapping a track inside a playlist or album does.
options.title: Tap action

description: Removes advertisements and search recommendations, clears advertising identifiers, keeps advertising consent disabled, and removes the unsolicited VK ID prompt, with options for additional interface cleanup.
name: Disable ads

options.description: Disables loyalty onboarding, points, notifications, links, and cashback banners.
options.title: Disable loyalty program

options.description: Removes the Featured and Games tabs and opens Apps by default.
options.title: Hide Featured and Games tabs

options.description: Removes notification buttons from the search bar and Mine screen.
options.title: Hide notification buttons

description: Disables analytics and tracking in RuStore.
name: Disable analytics

description: Disables RuStore network-state monitoring, built-in VPN sessions, and startup hooks.
name: Disable background hooks

description: Disables the periodic Kaspersky background device scan.
name: Disable background scan

description: Removes courier tips UI and prevents tip IDs or tip API calls from being submitted.
name: Disable checkout tips

description: Removes the Game Profile and usage statistics access, hides both gaming cards, and blocks navigation to the profile.
name: Disable gaming profile

description: Removes privileged, phone, SMS, location, storage, billing, USB, and vendor access.
name: Disable invasive permissions

description: Disables lottery onboarding and the in-app push SDK used for reward popups.
name: Disable lottery and in-app pushes

description: Reverts the Mine screen to the classic layout, disabling the redesigned V2/V3 interface.
name: Disable Mine redesign

description: Removes the warning shown when Ozon Bank detects an active VPN connection.
name: Disable Ozon Bank VPN warning

description: Disables RuStore and VK remote push services and background tasks.
name: Disable push services

description: Disables Ozon analytics, attribution, crash reporting, and telemetry uploads.
name: Disable telemetry

description: Suppresses Ozon push notifications asking the user to leave a pickup-point tip.
name: Disable tip notifications

description: Excludes Google Play installs from RuStore update checks while keeping RuStore and sideloaded apps.
name: Exclude Google Play apps from updates

description: Removes the lottery entry banner and review feed shortcut from the account screen.
name: Hide account lottery and review feed

description: Removes the advertising banner carousel from the Ozon Bank screen.
name: Hide Ozon Bank ad banner

description: Adds options to hide selected non-advertising sections from the Benefit page.
name: Hide Ozon Bank benefit sections

options.description: Hides the Buy for 1 ruble product carousel.
options.title: Hide Buy for 1 ruble

options.description: Hides the For shopping on Ozon section.
options.title: Hide For shopping on Ozon

options.description: Hides the Ozon Premium benefits section.
options.title: Hide Ozon Premium

description: Uses the classic home design and removes promotional cards, sections, shortcuts, and the startup installment offer from Ozon Bank pages.
name: Hide Ozon Bank promotions

description: Removes the post-purchase seller rating prompt.
name: Hide seller rating prompt

description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, checkout promotions, floating promotions, banner carousels, and PDP promo blocks.
name: Remove Ozon ads

options.description: Removes recommendation grids from product, cart, profile, and favorites screens.
options.title: Hide recommendation grids

description: Preserves RuStore secure-session requests when the APK is re-signed.
name: Restore secure-session compatibility

description: Keeps background workers required for update checks, downloads, patching, and installation.
name: Restrict background work to updates

description: Hides crossed-out prices, discount percentages, and redundant price rows in the cart total.
name: Show final prices only

description: Skips the VK ID authorization suggestion shown during app installs and updates.
name: Skip update authentication

description: Publishes the video like status and id in MediaMetadata, so external apps can read them through a MediaController.
name: Expose like status in MediaSession

description: Removes ads by forcing TeamSnap+ Tier 1 subscription status.
name: Disable ads

description: Forces pure-black app background in dark mode (window_background_color -> #000000). Surfaces/cards keep stock greys; light mode untouched.
name: AMOLED black background

description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.
name: Disable audio ads

description: Playlist/album headers show Play + Shuffle instead of Shuffle + Edit/Follow/Like (functional LEAVECOLLAB, local-songs ADD_MORE and podcasts untouched). Pulls in 'Unforce shuffle'.
name: Header Play + Shuffle

description: Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.
name: Hide Gold features

description: Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.
name: Hide shuffle badges

description: Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.
name: Hide upgrade upsell

description: Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, disables the karaoke feature itself, and hides the player/playlist AI MIX buttons. Feature UI stays hidden rather than paywalled.
name: Hide upsell feature buttons
